authorized_by: ASYM-BETA-0024: daily latency cap improves June but leaves April 2024 essentially unchanged.
question: Did the already-frozen 20d/60d BTC trend components weaken or turn negative during April 2024 while the 120d/240d components remained positive enough to keep aggregate btc_trend positive and the extra-beta sleeve active?

scope.all_history_diagnostic: count masked-reversal days over the full completed sample

masked_reversal_definitions.20d_60d_negative_aggregate_positive: component20 < 0 and component60 < 0 and aggregate btc_trend > 0

required_outputs: exact daily 20/60/120/240 components and weighted contributions
validation that weighted component sum equals existing btc_trend
first natural zero crossing dates for each component in the April and June windows
days where short components are negative while aggregate trend remains positive
forward BTC returns after masked-reversal days for descriptive attribution only
comparison of April 2024 with all other masked-reversal episodes
prohibited: no changing trend weights or horizons
no testing alternative component thresholds beyond the natural zero sign already embedded in the trend definition
no claim that a component sign crossing itself is an approved trading rule
next_experiment_rule: Only if the existing short-horizon components clearly weaken before the April loss while aggregate trend stays positive may a separately preregistered experiment give short-horizon confirmation narrow veto authority over extra beta. Otherwise the next attribution must move to another already-existing feature before adding new information.
